title: The Andhra Pradesh Land Licensed Cultivators Act, 2011
full_text: The Andhra Pradesh Land Licensed Cultivators Act, 2011 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201118 Act Number: 18 Enactment Date: 2011-12-23 Act Year: 2011 Short Title: The Andhra Pradesh Land Licensed Cultivators Act, 2011 Long Title: AN ACT TO PROVIDE LOAN AND OTHER BENEFITS ELIGIBILITY CARD TO THE FARMERS, WHO RAISE CROPS WITH EXPRESS OR IMPLIED PERMISSION OF OWNER OR PATTADAR OF LAND, BUT HAVE NO RECORD FOR SUCH ENJOYMENT WITHOUT EFFECTING THE RIGHTS OF OWNERS, ENABLING THEM TO ACCESS CREDIT FROM THE PUBLIC FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS AND TO CLAIM BENEFITS OF INPUT SUBSIDY, CROP INSURANCE, COMPENSATION FOR DAMAGE TO CROP AND FOR MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH AND INCIDENTAL THERETO.
